verdicts.reason: Both are nearly identical stacked skyscrapers. Both move the URL above the event details, which breaks the reading order. Both leave large uneven dead gaps between blocks, and the event fine print at the bottom is tiny and hard to read. B is slightly worse: its pink body copy leaves 'VIRTUAL' as an orphan on its own line and runs close to the right edge, and its 'IT'S TIME…' line is smaller, which weakens the hierarchy. A wraps more cleanly and keeps that subhead stronger.
